description: This PHP class defines a REST API endpoint for retrieving the configuration of the timesheet time format in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base Endpoint class and implements ResourceEndpoint, providing a method to fetch the current time format setting, along with validation rules and unimplemented methods for updating and deleting the resource.

classes.name: TimesheetTimeFormatAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API resource for retrieving the timesheet time format configuration within the OrangeHRM system.
